title: ELEKTRON Enterprise Standards (EES)
classification: Enterprise Engineering Standard / Single Source of Truth

authored.note: declared_status is the AUTHORED target state, not an achieved repository state. See lifecycle_state / validation_state for the governing status.

repository.reason: CONTROLLED_BASELINE, not VALIDATED: a CONTROLLED_BASELINE is a reviewed, change-controlled working target (EES s3.1 BASELINE band, v0.1.x-v0.9.x). VALIDATED requires the s7.2 Author -> Reviewer -> EASB sign-off chain plus attached evidence, none of which is recorded in-repo (Principle 1: Evidence Before Assumption).

baseline_promotion.note: Honest interim authority. This authorizes a controlled baseline only; it is NOT a VALIDATED release approval and does not substitute for the s7.2 chain.

generated_artifacts.note: Deterministic presentation output. Not the canonical source. Regenerate via 'make standards-verify' / the generator; never hand-edit.
